abstract: Serum levels of testosterone, luteinizing hormone and follicle-stimulating hormone were measured in 73 patients with germ cell testicular cancer in stages I and II. Blood samples were taken after unilateral orchidectomy but immediately before irradiation and chemotherapy, and again 1 to 3 years after cessation of therapy. No difference was found between pre- and post-treatment testosterone values. Patients who received radiotherapy only, had similar pre- and post-treatment luteinizing hormone values, whereas the patients who received chemotherapy in addition to irradiation still had elevated luteinizing hormone values 1 to 3 years after cessation of therapy. These values fell towards the pretreatment levels during the follow-up period. Levels of follicle-stimulating hormone were already higher than normal before treatment and increased further during treatment.
abstract_ja: 精巣摘除術後、放射線療法および化学療法の前と、治療終了の1〜3年後に、病期I・IIの精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者73例から血清を採取し、テストステロン、黄体形成ホルモン（LH）、卵胞刺激ホルモン（FSH）を測定した。治療前後でテストステロン値に差は認められなかった。放射線療法のみを受けた患者ではLH値が治療前後で同様であったが、放射線療法に加えて化学療法を受けた患者では、治療終了後1〜3年の時点でもLH値は高値のままであった。FSH値は治療前からすでに高値であり、治療中にさらに上昇した。これらの値は追跡期間中に治療前の値へ戻っていった。
